scheme_name: Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person
other_conditions: Disability of both bride and bridegroom must be 40% or above
Marriage must be the first marriage for both parties
Application must be submitted within 120 days after marriage
Application should be submitted at least 30 days before the proposed marriage date
benefits_summary: Incentive of ₹2,00,000 (₹40,000 cash and ₹1,60,000 as NSC)
